name: The Journeyman Project 3: Legacy of Time

locations.note: Shangri-La is one of three lost civilizations the player visits, reached through the Himalayas in AD 1219.
The legendary golden city of El Dorado is one of the three lost civilizations the player visits, in the Andes in AD 524.
Atlantis is one of three lost civilizations the player visits, reached in 1262 BC under the Mediterranean.
